response.sql: WITH race_circuits AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, r.round FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), circuit_averages AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS average_round FROM race_circuits GROUP BY circuitId, country), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS baseline_round FROM race_circuits GROUP BY country), differences AS (SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.average_round, ca.average_round - co.baseline_round AS round_difference FROM circuit_averages AS ca JOIN country_averages AS co ON ca.country IS co.country) SELECT circuitId, country, average_round, round_difference FROM differences ORDER BY round_difference IS NULL, round_difference DESC LIMIT 10
